interactiveEvidence.loader: The live DOM uses [data-loader] with the hero title and a numeric progress value. Runtime evidence sets a 3s expo.inOut progress, 3s cubic.inOut exit, and header/aside reveal with a 1s delay over 2s.
interactiveEvidence.menu: Open reaches a 90% page frame at ~700ms and text settles by ~2.1s; close fades by ~480ms.
interactiveEvidence.pointer: A fixed WebGL layer accumulates movement-driven distortion and decays after movement stops in image-led sections. The black School, Craft, and Retreat stack plus the supplied recording's Company/IZANAMI-to-Footer range are pointer-silent regions: entering one clears the accumulated field and hides the composite until the pointer leaves. The source runtime globally forwards desktop pointer movement, so these disabled boundaries are established by the supplied recordings and explicit requested behavior; the alpha-zero mesh architecture explains the visible result but does not itself prove suppression. Evidence: source/pointer-states.json, source-runtime.js:26443-26509, 34025-34172, and 34894-34915.
interactiveEvidence.hover: The inactive JA link and regular Footer links roll original text to -110% and the clone from 130% to 0 while a left-origin line grows over 700ms quart.out. Footer whatsapp, Instagram, and privacy policy additionally preserve the source clone-target geometry: the text clip and strike line share grid-area 1 / 1, the clip uses overflow: clip with 0.1em block padding, and the labels retain source casing rather than a forced uppercase transform. At 1280x720 their settled widths are exactly 64.609375/72.0703125/100.25px in both source and clone, and their 180ms transform matrices match. MENU adds the source's vertical dot exchange. CTA buttons and the large Footer Philosophy link use the separate 130% button runtime: one full-width line translates from a geometry-derived idle offset through the text, enter takes 0.7s, and the line returns over 1.1s. The Footer next link also reproduces the source intersection entry sweep and staggered character reveal. Evidence: source/hover-states.json, source/footer-link-hover-states-20260813.json, source-runtime.js:38469-38625 and 40891-41020, source.css:417-447 and 1615-1624, captures/reference-164327/, and the local Footer QA receipts.
interactiveEvidence.scroll: The live 1918x928 page is 11499px tall. Its projects target spans 4343.875-6261.875px, while the unclipped desktop WebGL mesh moves at 0.8 of scroll and fades from targetRect.bottom / viewportHeight. This makes the architecture visible beneath the entering Philosophy collage and beneath School until the sticky target reaches the viewport top. Three natural project panels total 2702px, while the target is compressed by half the first panel to 2252.46875px. Lenis uses its default lerp 0.1 and wheelMultiplier 1. Company itself is not pinned: live source and clone both move its content -321px for a 321px scroll before the Footer handoff. The 1470x802 verification reproduces the supplied 2026-08-10 recording at y=1800, 2200, 3900, 4500, and 4800; the 2026-08-14 matched-duration Company/Footer run recorded 323 frames, 17.4ms P95, no frame over 20ms, and no long task. Evidence: source/scroll-states.json, source/company-footer-scroll-20260814.json, source-runtime.js:32279-32448 and 38933-39062, captures/reference-scroll-contact-sheet.png, and captures/reference-101714/.
interactiveEvidence.heroColor: The local and live /assets/img/home_fv_img.webp files share SHA-256 52704c10a34ffdd97edc9148c925048b6e01ffd3bafd2f68f575ff8d8612447b. interactiveEvidence.locales: The source header uses / for EN and /ja/ for JA, with data-no-swup route reloads and the active language circle. Source /ja/ retains English navigation, headings, project names, buttons, locations, clocks, and Hero phrase while translating Philosophy, Projects intro, School/Craft/Retreat, and three Company paragraphs. The clone implements the same route/content split from source/raw-ja.html. Codex in-app Browser exercised JA then EN by visible controls at 1470x802 and 390x844; /ja/ reported document lang=ja, Shippori Mincho, JA aria-current=page, exact Japanese copy, and scrollWidth=clientWidth. The mobile Company opening paragraph uses the source spBr-equivalent continuation break.
